results.jd_text:
Senior Software Development Engineer \n 
 
 
 Primary Skills 
 
 DB2 
 
 
 Job requirements 
 
 AS400 Developer Experience: 3–5 years Department: Digital Engineering Employment Type: Full-time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced AS400 (IBM i) Developer to design, develop, and maintain business-critical applications on the IBM iSeries platform. The ideal candidate has strong RPG programming skills, a solid understanding of DB2 for i, and experience supporting and modernizing legacy enterprise systems. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain applications on the IBM i (AS400/iSeries) platform using RPG (RPG IV / RPGLE / Free-format RPG), CL, and SQL. Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications and robust solutions. Develop and optimize DB2 for i database objects — physical/logical files, tables, views, and stored procedures. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime for business-critical systems. Perform code reviews, unit testing, and support system integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Maintain and enhance existing legacy applications while supporting modernization initiatives (e.g., migration to free-format RPG, web enablement, API integration). Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, QA, and infrastructure teams. Create and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions. Adhere to coding standards, change management processes, and SDLC best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in AS400/IBM i application development. Strong proficiency in RPG IV, RPGLE, and Free-format RPG. Solid experience with CL (Control Language) programming. Strong knowledge of DB2 for i and embedded SQL / SQLRPGLE. Experience with development tools such as RDi (Rational Developer for i), PDM, SEU, and DDS. Good understanding of file structures (physical and logical files), data areas, and data queues. Experience in debugging, performance tuning, and production support. Familiarity with version control and change management tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Warehouse Management Systems, Food Sales/Service Apps Experience with modernization tools (e.g., web services / REST APIs on IBM i, Profound UI, or similar). Knowledge of integration technologies (MQ, EDI, or middleware). Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. IBM i certifications. Soft Skills Ability to work independently and within a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Effective collaboration and stakeholder communication.

results.title: Java Developer (R-19995)
results.jd_text:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet 
 
 At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at  dnb.com/careers . 
 
 
 Job Summary: 
 
   
 
 We are looking for a Software Engineer II with 6+ years of relevant hands-on experience in Java backend development to design, build, and support scalable enterprise applications. The role requires practical experience with Java, Spring Boot, cloud platforms, databases, integrations, CI/CD, Agile delivery, and AI-assisted engineering tools \n 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based enterprise applications using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 
 Develop and support cloud-enabled applications on AWS and Google Cloud Platform. 
 
 Build and maintain integrations using Web Services, Oracle Service Bus, XML, XSL/XSLT, and FTL. 
 
 Work with Oracle, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server for application development, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 
 Support CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, deployments, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution. 
 
 Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and business stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment. 
 
 Demonstrate the ability to work on multiple applications and priorities in parallel, while maintaining delivery quality, responsiveness, and clear communication. 
 
 Use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and Gemini Code Assist to improve productivity, quality, testing, and documentation. 
 
 
 Key Skills: 
 
 Backend Engineering: Java 1.8+, J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 
 Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-based application support (GCP good to have). 
 
 Database: Oracle, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, SQL development, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 
 Integration: Web Services, Oracle Service Bus(good to have), XML, XSL/XSLT, FTL, JBoss, and Apache Tomcat. 
 
 Tools: Shell Scripting, Jira, Confluence, Agile delivery, and technical documentation. 
 
 AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini Code Assist, or similar tools. 
 
 Preferred Exposure: Terraform, Angular, Python, Hadoop, or Scala. 
 
 
 
 \n 
 Internally, this position is titled as Software Engineer II. 
 
 
 All Dun & Bradstreet job postings can be found at https://jobs.lever.co/dnb . Official communication from Dun & Bradstreet will come from an email address ending in @dnb.com.
